name: VirtualList
description: Fixed-height windowed list with overscan and explicit assistive-technology position metadata.

ariaRequirements: viewport uses role=list and an accessible name
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-26 — list semantics, item position metadata, rendered range behavior, and axe result reviewed in unit tests. 2026-08-04 — Phase 1 pass: light/dark/forced-colors verified in a real browser; windowing asserted at 10,000 rows (DOM capped at visible+overscan, true posinset/setsize); scroll-window focusability play; scroll-stability latency measured; AT-tree and real-browser forced-colors evidence captured.

dense: fixed-height windowed collection; overscan, stable keys, rendered-range callback, aria position and set-size metadata

getItemProps.description:
Maps an item to its VirtualListItem chrome (label via `children`, plus
optional `icon`, `meta`, `trailingIcon`, `selected`, `tone`). VirtualList
injects the position (`posInSet`/`setSize`) and windowing style.

overscan.description: Extra rows rendered before and after the viewport.

forbiddenUse: use it when browser find-in-page must search every item

usage.description: Use VirtualList for long, fixed-height collections when rendering every item would be wasteful. Keep item keys stable and row height accurate.

bestPractices.description: Measure and provide the exact fixed row height used by rendered items.
Use stable item keys that survive filtering, sorting, and refreshes.
Keep overscan small while preventing blank edges during normal scrolling.
Use range changes for prefetching without coupling them to visual state.
Do not virtualize a short collection that renders cheaply without it.
Do not use VirtualList for variable-height rows or full-page text search.
